description: Decide whether one more round of a negotiation is worth what it costs (the optimal stopping rule, POST /api/negotiate/stop). Send your role, the currency and the offers so far in context.history (two or more, or a prior in next_round.estimated_improvement); optionally best_offer, reservation, horizon, counterparty_horizon, budget_remaining, opponent_patience, disclosure, next_round (its estimated_cost, or the function_id it would run so the cost is metered) and value_model (linear with marginal_value_per_unit, or function with function_id: a registered value estimator). Answers whether to stop, the best offer so far, the expected value and the cost of one more round, the crossing (rounds still worth playing and the expected final price), the driver (whose economics force the stop) and a plain explanation, then the action (continue, accept or walk away), the reason and the metering. One metered compute call. Answers 404 until it is switched on for your workspace; until then compute_price with the lastprice/stopping-rule function gives the same decision. Needs a Last Price credential with the price:compute scope.

context.description: The negotiation, as POST /api/negotiate/stop takes it.

best_offer.description: The best price on the table now. Defaults to the latest offer in history.

counterparty_horizon.description: Your estimate of the counterparty's total round limit.

disclosure.description: What the counterparty knows about your limit. Defaults to uncertain.

history.description: Offers so far, one per round, as { round, offer }.

next_round.description: The next round: its cost (estimated_cost), or the function it would run (function_id) for a metered cost, and an optional prior on its improvement.

estimated_cost.description: Your own cost of the next round, in currency.

estimated_improvement.description: Your prior on the next improvement, in price units.

function_id.description: What the next round would run, an id or a built-in name.

input_units.description: Input units for the metered cost.

output_units.description: Output units for the metered cost.

reservation.description: Your walk-away price; a stop past it says walk_away.

role.description: Your side. A seller gains when offers rise, a buyer when they fall.

round.description: Rounds played so far. Defaults to the last round in history.

value_model.description: How a better price converts to value: {"type":"linear","marginal_value_per_unit":1} (the default) or {"type":"function","function_id":"..."}.

function_id.description: For function: the id or name of the value estimator.

marginal_value_per_unit.description: For linear: value per unit of price improvement. Defaults to 1.

options.description: fairness_mode (default false) caps your rounds at the counterparty's smaller horizon.

fairness_mode.description: Cap your rounds at the counterparty's smaller horizon. Defaults to false.

name: negotiate_stop
